quotes.quote: She killed three children. Those children's lives are gone. The fact that people are outside the courthouse for her, it's sickening to me. quotes.quote: TJ McConnell has had to play a role his whole career. He has not been able to get the ball, like I'm, well, he's gotten the ball with Indiana and look what he's doing. He's been with them for years. But that's what people don't understand. It's like, at the end of the day, I'm going to be honest, when you are on a team, they already have their superstar. You have a role to play. When you were with the Pistons, when you were with Milwaukee, were you the guy? You had to go out there and play your role.

quotes.speaker: Ray Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Ray Felton on his transition from star to role player
quotes.excerpt: I went from averaging 30 points a game to averaging 12 fucking points at Carolina.
quotes.quote: I'm about year 11 in the league. I'm over 30. You know, I'm still not the same young spring chicken I was when I first came in the league at like 21. I'm in Florida. Josh Howard will remember this story. Josh Howard said he just saw this clip, probably like two years ago about it. He saw this clip, we playing in this own pro-am league in Florida. We went down there and played in this tournament down there and this dude was just talking shit like, 'Yeah, yeah, you lead niggas think y'all y'all can do this, y'all can do that.' Yeah, man. So I'm just cruising. I'm just out there just staying in shape, you know, I ain't really trying to get hurt. I got to go play in the season. When I tell you, I gave this man 50 in one half. Like, you know, because he like, he activated me. I had to show him. And then when I got done, I said, 'Listen, this is why I'm a pro.' No disrespect to you, I wish you the best wherever you trying to do overseas, whatever you trying to do. But I make a living to do this. I make a living to put this motherfucker in the basket. I gave this nigga 50 in the first in the whole second half talking shit. And that's why they don't understand the levels of that shit. Like, we perfected what we had to do. So when we go to a team, yeah, I went from averaging 30 points a game to averaging 12 fucking points at Carolina.
